comment: Cases for the organization commands, run against the sample organization by BOTH engines: the Rust mock HQ (src-tauri/src/org_engine.rs) and the TypeScript browser mock (src/lib/org/reducer.ts). Each case applies its setup commands, then the command; `expect` is `ok` or the error code. Commands carry no command_id: the runner adds one. The sample: office id 'office-1', teams at version 1, memberships ms-1..ms-11. Setup commands must succeed.
